login.headline: Sign in to your server.
login.intro: GoToSocial, Mastodon, Akkoma and other servers with the Mastodon API. You approve access on your server's own page.
login.blueskyIntro: Sign in with your Bluesky handle, or the address of your own PDS. You approve access on your server's sign-in page.
login.blueskyPasswordIntro: Sign in with an app password or your account password. Some servers, including many self-hosted ones, don't offer app passwords.
login.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead
login.useOAuth: Sign in with your server's page instead

signUp.agree: I agree to the rules and terms of {{server}}
signUp.birthDate: Date of birth (you must be at least {{age}})

signUp.reason: Why do you want to join?
